data: What is the approximate maximum value of the KL Divergence for the blue dots in Figure 4b?

The question asks for the approximate maximum value of the KL Divergence for the blue dots in Figure 4b. From the caption, we know that the CNN model divergences are highlighted in large blue dots, and the KL Divergence values are shown on the left y-axis. By analyzing the graph, we can see that the blue dots reach their highest point at approximately 0.0275 on the y-axis. Therefore, the approximate maximum value of the KL Divergence for the blue dots in Figure 4b is 0.0275.
